caption: A dark stage lighting rig fills a side-by-side stereo fisheye view, its left and right halves appearing symmetrical across a near-black gap. Overhead trusses carry bright white LED strips and rows of round orange dots, while a diagonal arm of orange dots hangs from each top corner. Across the early frames these orange dots brighten and the corner arms become more fully visible, extending inward, as the small outlined fixture clusters low in each half remain lit in place. Volumetric white beams then emerge from the upper moving-head fixtures, angling downward and inward. The beams intensify until they cross near the center in an X, and a crowd of tiny white human silhouettes along the bottom edge becomes progressively lit. The sequence keeps its bilateral symmetry throughout.
relations: As orange dots brighten, corner arms extend inward while low fixture clusters remain lit.
Upper moving-head fixtures emit white beams that angle downward and inward.
Intensifying beams cross near the center in an X shape.
The crossing beams progressively illuminate a crowd of tiny silhouettes along the bottom edge.
